dictionary.capacity_action: raise explicit capacity error, no truncation
dictionary.insufficient_samples: explicit unavailable if fewer than dictionary size
dictionary.neighborhood: weak one-hop induced subgraph retaining directed edges and center
dictionary.partition: seeded permutation chunks; min(32,chunk size) medoids each; recursively cluster medoids to 32
dictionary.representative: medoid minimizing within-cluster sum distance; ties sample index
dictionary.sampling: without replacement over (training week,center); equal initial mass per candidate; after selection halve weights of remaining centers inside sampled neighborhood in that week
dictionary.training_scope: only graph snapshots fully available inside training interval

matching.convergence: temperature termination; no additional fixed-point stopping
matching.hardening: greedy global maximum; ties row-major; remove row and column; stop after min(n,m) matches
matching.initialization: node agreement s2 (Algorithm1 s1 symbol corrected by argument type)
matching.objective: paper Eq1 literal including factor 2 in edge denominator
matching.precision_accelerated: float32 output with float64 affinity and annealing
matching.rectangular: un-padded rectangular one-pass normalization; soft row/column sums need not both equal 1; hard assignment must be injective
matching.s1: edge RBF exp(-mean squared feature difference); zero if either edge absent
matching.s2: node RBF exp(-mean squared feature difference)
matching.update: Q_ui=0.5*sum_vj(edge_agreement_uvij*M_vj)+alpha*node_agreement_ui; literal Algorithm1, not claimed Eq2 derivative
matching.zero_edges: edge contribution zero if either graph has zero edges; retain node contribution divided by (1+alpha)
